  "title": "Pass Global Privacy Control header to bidders",
  "body": "We've discussed the latest Global Privacy Control (GPC) with privacy lawyers and would like to start simply by passing the HTTP header along to bidders. \r\n\r\nPer https://globalprivacycontrol.github.io/gpc-spec/, the header is `Sec-GPC`\r\n\r\nAll PBS needs to do is copy the Sec-GPC HTTP header from the original request through to the bidder endpoints.       "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Hi @bretg I wanted to bring to your attention [this approach](https://github.com/prebid/prebid-server/pull/1789/files#diff-9901dba73134efb17928d7f25f4569f684ab511119f10a691ce7d7fc657ca535R138-R142) as passing the header to adapter servers in the HTTP headers isn't mentioned in the PBS specifications as suggested by @SyntaxNode [here](https://github.com/prebid/prebid-server/pull/1789#discussion_r630518613)\r\n\r\nI will really appreciate it if you can provide some guidance here. Thanks in advance. "
